title: Use separate lookbook attachments per member (e.g., Lookbook 1=M1 main…
content: Use separate lookbook attachments per member (e.g., Lookbook 1=M1 main, Lookbook 2=M2, Lookbook 3=M3) to lock each idol member’s exact face consistently in Seedance 2.0.
tips: Use separate lookbook attachments per member (e.g., Lookbook 1=M1 main, Lookbook 2=M2, Lookbook 3=M3) to lock each idol member’s exact face consistently in Seedance 2.0.

en.content: Use separate lookbook attachments for each member (e.g., Lookbook 1 = M1 main, Lookbook 2 = M2, Lookbook 3 = M3) to consistently lock in each idol member’s exact face in Seedance 2.0.

es.content: Usa archivos adjuntos de lookbook separados por miembro (p. ej., Lookbook 1 = M1 principal, Lookbook 2 = M2, Lookbook 3 = M3) para fijar de forma consistente el rostro exacto de cada miembro del grupo idol en Seedance 2.0.

fr.content: Utilisez des pièces jointes de lookbook séparées pour chaque membre (par ex. : Lookbook 1 = M1 principal, Lookbook 2 = M2, Lookbook 3 = M3) afin de verrouiller de manière cohérente le visage exact de chaque membre du groupe idol dans Seedance 2.0.

ja.content: 各メンバーごとに個別のルックブック添付ファイルを使用し（例：Lookbook 1＝M1メイン、Lookbook 2＝M2、Lookbook 3＝M3）、Seedance 2.0で各アイドルメンバーの正確な顔を一貫して固定します。

pt.content: Use anexos de lookbook separados por membro (por exemplo, Lookbook 1 = M1 principal, Lookbook 2 = M2, Lookbook 3 = M3) para travar com consistência o rosto exato de cada integrante do idol no Seedance 2.0.

zh.content: 在 Seedance 2.0 中，为每位成员分别使用独立的 lookbook 附件（例如：Lookbook 1 = M1 主体，Lookbook 2 = M2，Lookbook 3 = M3），以稳定锁定每位偶像成员的准确面部特征。
